jobs.title: Director, Autism Program and Service Planning
jobs.description:
**What We Do:**  
Children’s Treatment Network (CTN) supports over 42,000 kids and youth with disabilities and other developmental needs. We provide intake, service navigation and coordinated service planning, assessment and diagnostic services, specialized clinics and rehabilitation services, including physiotherapy, occupational therapy and speech language therapy.

Funded by the Ministry of Children, Community and Social Services, CTN is an Ontario provincial government funded not\-for profit organization, that offers services through contracted partners in the education, health and community sectors. Through its innovative network model, CTN’s commitment to providing family\-centered care is anchored by an electronic client record that is shared across its partner organizations and provides the foundation for integrated plans of care and services.

Dedicated to creating a vibrant community where all kids, youth and families belong, we have a strong commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion, Indigeneity and accessibility. With this in mind, our goal is a workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome all qualified applicants to apply including individuals with disabilities, those who identify as Black, Indigenous or persons of colour, members of the LGBTQ2S\+ communities and others. We are proud to be in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA), 2005 and the Integrated Accessibility Standards Regulation. We are happy to honour accommodations at any part of the recruitment process and invite you to let us know how we can help.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive compensation and employee benefits package including participation in the Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP) and vacation/leave entitlement
* An opportunity to contribute to the work of a not\-for\-profit organization that provides services to kids and youth with disabilities and developmental needs and their families
* The chance to be a part of a culture with an organization that values inclusion, collaboration, responsibility, and innovation
* The opportunity to work with us to achieve CTN’s strategic goals of putting people at the centre of what we do, striving for excellence, fostering a culture of accountability and stewardship to support community needs, and transformation through equitable data\-driven service innovation

**What You Will Do:**  
CTN is looking for a full\-time Director, Autism Program and Service Planning who provides strategic leadership and operational oversight of CTN’s Autism and Service Planning services. This position is one of two Programs and Services Directors and holds accountability for service system development; service delivery and coordination; service monitoring, contract compliance, evaluation, and quality improvement. The Director is accountable for the optimization and effectiveness of operations, provide context to others who manage teams, and develop frameworks for relationships with key internal and/or external stakeholders. The Director envisions changes, responds to risk, and identifies growth opportunities and fundamental improvement changes. The Director manages teams to ensure the appropriate capacity and capabilities are in place to deliver the required operational services. The position is actively involved with the ongoing development of the Network’s planning, development, and integration; and is a member of CTN’s Senior Management Team. This position reports to the Vice President, Programs and System Partnerships.

**Responsibilities:**  
The successful incumbent will be responsible for the following duties and responsibilities:

**Service Delivery:**

* Collaborate with programs and services and network partner managers to ensure:
* evidence informed clinical protocols and service pathways
* coordinated service delivery and integrated care plans
* inter\-professional practice protocols
* family centred service delivery
* Ensure that CTN’s clinical policies and procedures meet the mandate, mission and service agreement requirements for the delivery of all CTN funded services
* Ensure appropriate consistency of service delivery across multiple partners
* Implement strategies to leverage the clinical network outside of the hosted resources to provide optimum solutions to services for the clients of CTN
* Pilot innovative clinical practices in response to identified service gaps and needs and determine resourcing to support these
* Monitor and assess the waitlist, case\-loads and service delivery data to support resource allocation strategies and budgeting on an annual basis, and monitor the service gaps and needs for year\-end adjustments
* Support the Director, Corporate Services in developing and monitoring the programs and services budget, assist in variance analysis and forecasting financial and service projections
* Ensure appropriate risk management response to family relations issues, programs and services related risk situations and individual clinical issues of an extraordinary nature related to programs and services

**Contract Management:**

* Ensure compliance with, and support network partners in monitoring and achieving, contractual obligations with respect to service targets and service descriptions including quality management
* Serve as liaison for tertiary providers for clinical issues and in the negotiation of service provision contracts, and manage these contracts for effectiveness and compliance

**Local Team Operations:**

* Ensure appropriate clinical activities, family and provider engagement and inter\-professional programs and activities at the local team sites
* Develop an approach to risk management for local teams including response to family relations and local team issues
* Ensure awareness of and access to local team sites amongst providers, families and referral sources
* Ensure coordination with Corporate Services in regard to the operational requirements of the satellite sites, heal

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology and Transformation Risk
jobs.description:
**Experience Aviva**

  

Together, we are Aviva.

  

  

Our values of Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence guide how we show up for each other and our customers. At Aviva Canada, we put people first through a culture built on inclusion, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

  

  

**The Opportunit** y

  

  

The VP Technology and Transformation Risk is a senior member of the Canada Risk function, responsible for providing independent second line oversight and challenge across Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks. The role supports the effective management of these risks across Aviva Canada, helping ensure business objectives can be delivered within the Aviva Canada’s risk appetite framework and regulatory expectations.

  

  

The role partners closely with Group and local stakeholders to provide independent risk advice, oversight and challenge, supporting the ongoing development of risk management practices and frameworks across technology and transformation activities.

  

  

Risks within the role holder's remit include Cyber Risk, Data Risk, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Emerging Technology Risk and other IT risks.


The role leads specialist risk teams and works closely with colleagues across Risk, Technology, Operations and Transformation functions to provide insight on emerging risks, monitor risk exposures, and support consistent application of Aviva Canada and Group policies and standards.

  

  

**What you'll do**

  

* Provide independent second line oversight and challenge of Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks across the Group.
* Partner with senior leaders within Technology, Operations, Customer \& Marketing and Transformation functions to support effective risk management and informed decision\-making.
* Monitor and assess technology and transformation risk exposures, providing insights and recommendations to senior management and risk committees.
* Support the development, maintenance and implementation of Aviva Canada and Group risk frameworks, policies, standards and risk appetite measures relating to Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks
* Contribute to risk reporting and analysis provided to Board Risk Committee and Executive Committees as required.
* Provide independent review and challenge of significant technology and transformation initiatives, including major change programs and strategic investments
* Support regulatory engagement activities and the provision of evidence relating to Technology, Cyber, Data and Transformation risk management practices.
* Oversee the identification and assessment of technology concentration, critical dependency and third\-party risks across key platforms, suppliers and services.
* Monitor emerging technology developments and evolving risk trends, providing thought leadership and practical guidance to business stakeholders
* Promote consistency in the application of risk policies, frameworks and methodologies across Aviva Canada.
* Lead and develop specialist risk teams, creating a high\-performance culture and strengthening risk expertise across Technology and Transformation disciplines.
* Contribute to the development and execution of the wider Risk Function strategy and priorities.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across the Risk Function, including the adoption of data, technology and agile ways of working.
  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

* A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Business, or a related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in data governance, data management, analytics, or a related discipline.
* Relevant Insurance qualifications and/or Risk professional qualifications, CRM, CRMP, FRM, PRM or equivalent
* Significant experience in enterprise risk management within a regulated financial services or insurance environment, including application of the Three Lines of Defense model
* Deep expertise in Technology, Cyber, Data, AI, Operational Resilience and Third\-Party Risk oversight and governance
* Proven oversight of large\-scale transformation and change programs, including complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
* Experience partnering with senior executives (CIO, COO, business leaders) and influencing strategic decisions
* Strong people leadership experience, including building, leading and developing high\-performing specialist teams
* Experience engaging with regulators, audit functions, executive committees and board\-level stakeholders on risk matters.
  

  

**What you'll get**

  

* Competitive executive compensation package, including annual incentive opportunities.
* Comprehensive pension and retirement savings programs.
* Flexible hybrid work model.
* Industry\-leading health and wellness benefits.
* Professional development and executive leadership growth opportunities.
* Inclusive employee resource groups and diversity initiatives.
* Volunteer opportunities and community impact programs.
* Competitive vacation and wellness offerings.
  

  

This job advertisement is for an existing vacancy which has been posted both internally \& externally.  



  

Aviva Canada may use AI (Artificial Intelligence) tools to assist us throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for a position.  



  

Aviva Canada welcomes applications from all qualified individuals and has a process in place to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities at all stages of the hiring process and during employment. If you require an accommodation during the interview or hiring process, please contact your Aviva Talent Acquisition Partner so that an appropriate accommodation can be arranged.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees across multiple facilities in the Greater Toronto Area. We are adding a Director of Information Technology to our leadership team — a senior role with full ownership of the IT function and a direct hand in how this business operates and grows.

The scope is deliberately broad. Liteline is investing in artificial intelligence, automation, data infrastructure and connected business systems across the organization, and the Director of Information Technology will lead that work from the front.

This is an operating role as much as a technical one. The person in this position will work closely with leadership and with departments across the business, including Operations, Customer Service, Sales, Finance, Product Development, Manufacturing, Warehousing and Distribution.

**IT Strategy and Leadership**

* Own and develop Liteline's IT strategy and long\-term technology roadmap.
* Partner directly with senior leadership to set technology priorities and identify risks and investment opportunities.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where they create real operational or commercial value.
* Maintain and evolve the standards, policies and governance practices a growing organization requires.
* Lead technology planning across multiple facilities and business functions.
* Own IT budgets, capital planning, licensing, vendor spend and major technology investments.
* Lead the internal IT team and the external partners who support IT and set the service standards the business is held to.

**AI, Automation and Digital Transformation**

* Lead Liteline's adoption of artificial intelligence, automation and next\-generation business technologies.
* Find the highest\-value applications for automation across the business and build the case for them.
* Develop AI and automation solutions that lift productivity, sharpen decision\-making and strengthen the customer experience.
* Build the infrastructure and governance required to scale AI responsibly across the organization.
* Work directly with business leaders to move successful initiatives from experimentation into production.
* Embed data and automation into everyday business operations.

**Business Systems and Data**

* Own the architecture and ongoing development of Liteline's core business systems.
* Oversee ERP, databases, reporting systems, integrations and other enterprise applications.
* Own the platforms supporting our customer\-facing teams, including order management, pricing and product information.
* Own system integration and the flow of information between departments and facilities.
* Lead Liteline's data strategy, covering structure, accessibility, security, integration, reporting and business intelligence.
* Partner with functions across the business on system capability, visibility and usability.
* Keep technology platforms scalable and aligned to where the business is heading.

**Cybersecurity, Infrastructure and Business Continuity**

* Own Liteline's cybersecurity strategy, policies, controls and risk\-management framework.
* Maintain a strong security posture across endpoints, servers, networks, cloud services, applications and user access.
* Oversee infrastructure including servers, networking, storage, virtualization, cloud environments and telecommunications.
* Maintain tested backup, disaster\-recovery and business\-continuity capability.
* Maintain the monitoring, patching and access\-control practices that keep the environment defensible.
* Manage external technology and cybersecurity partners.
* Keep infrastructure stable, secure, scalable and resilient.

**Technology Operations**

* Maintain high availability and reliability across critical systems.
* Own the service standards, escalation paths and accountability for technology issues.
* Deliver a technology experience that makes it easy for more than 160 employees to do their best work.
* Manage relationships with key technology vendors, service providers and consultants.
* Keep Liteline's platforms and commercial arrangements current, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.
* Deliver projects on scope, on schedule and with the documentation to support them.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for an experienced technology leader who operates comfortably at both the strategic and the technical level.

The successful candidate will understand enterprise infrastructure, business applications, cybersecurity, data and emerging technologies, and will also understand that technology exists to serve the business. You should be able to step onto the floor, understand how the work is genuinely performed, and design practical solutions that people adopt and keep using.

Strong candidates will bring:

* Significant experience leading information technology in a complex business environment.
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking, servers, cloud technologies and enterprise systems.
* Experience with cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk management and business continuity.
* A strong grasp of databases, systems integration, data architecture and business intelligence.
* Experience with ERP and other enterprise business applications.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence, automation and modern development technologies.
* A record of leading major technology projects from strategy through implementation.
* Strong vendor\-management and commercial\-negotiation skills.
* The ability to communicate effectively with senior executives as well as operational and technical stakeholders.
* Sound business judgment and the ability to prioritize technology initiatives by business impact.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on\-site five days per week, with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

jobs.title: Director - Enterprise Data Warehouse and Data Platforms
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Director, Consulting Expert (DCE) – Enterprise Data Warehouse \& Data Platforms to provide senior technical, solutioning, and client facing leadership
  

The DCE will serve as a trusted advisor to the client while helping shape, win, govern, and successfully deliver complex enterprise data initiatives.  

This is not a narrow technical specialist or delivery only position. The DCE combines deep enterprise data warehouse and modern data platform expertise with consulting acumen, architecture leadership, commercial awareness, and executive presence. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior client stakeholders, shaping and estimating solutions, leading architecture decisions, and engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineering teams.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**


. Serve as a senior client facing advisor for enterprise data warehouse, data engineering, analytics, and data platform modernization initiatives within a complex telecommunications environment.  

. Translate business objectives and requirements into actionable data strategies, architectures, roadmaps, and solution options.  

. Lead end to end solution architecture, considering data, applications, integration, cloud, cybersecurity, operations, cost, scalability, and delivery trade offs.  

. Architect and guide enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including technologies such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Dataplex, Dataform, and Looker.  

. Provide technical leadership across enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, data quality, metadata, governance, security, and analytics.  

. Lead or co lead technical solutioning for strategic pursuits, proposals, RFPs, and account growth opportunities.  

. Develop and challenge solution scope, architecture, assumptions, estimates, resource models, dependencies, risks, and delivery approaches to ensure solutions are competitive and executable.  

. Orchestrate SMEs across data, cloud, applications, integration, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations to develop cohesive end to end solutions.  

. Lead or participate in architecture, estimation, proposal, and delivery governance reviews, identifying technical and delivery risks before commitments are made.  

. Advise on AI/ML and generative AI data readiness, including data quality, accessibility, governance, privacy, security, and responsible adoption.

. Mentor architects and technical leads and promote reusable architectures, patterns, accelerators, and solution assets across the team.  

. Partner with the DCS and broader P\&L leadership to strengthen the client relationship, identify growth opportunities, improve solution quality, and develop technical leadership capability within the team.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


. 10\+ years of progressively responsible experience in leading enterprise data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, solution architecture, or related IT consulting disciplines.  

. Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex enterprise data warehouse and modern cloud data platform solutions.  

. Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its data and analytics ecosystem, particularly Big Query and associated ingestion, processing, orchestration, governance, and analytics capabilities.  

. Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, ETL/ELT, data integration, data quality, metadata, security, governance, and analytics.  

. Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of modern data engineering technologies and practices such as Python, Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, APIs, and automated testing/deployment.  

. Experience with enterprise data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata, Informatica, DataStage, dbt, or comparable platforms.  

. Demonstrated experience leading solution architecture for significant client engagements, proposals, RFPs, or complex technology pursuits.  

. Experience developing or validating solution estimates, delivery models, assumptions, dependencies, and technical risks.  

. Strong consulting and executive communication skills, including discovery, problem framing, facilitation, solution development, and client presentations.  

. Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams, influence senior stakeholders, and mentor architects and technical leaders.  

. Working knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI concepts and their implications for enterprise data architecture and governance.  

  

Preferred Qualifications:  

  

. Experience delivering data and analytics solutions within the telecommunications industry, with an understanding of large scale, high volume telco data environments and associated business and operational use cases.  

. Google Cloud certification, particularly Professional Cloud Architect and/or Professional Data Engineer, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.  

. Experience modernizing large legacy or on premises enterprise data warehouse environments to GCP.

jobs.title: Director of Data
jobs.description:
**Purpose in Every Position**


Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI\-powered Global Work Platform, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185\+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere.

**Where Your Work Moves the Needle.**


At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**


We are seeking a highly technical, deeply analytical, and aggressively innovative Director of Data to lead our data strategy, infrastructure, and AI integration. You will not just be managing a team; you will be the chief storyteller for our data and the evangelist for our "AI Everywhere" initiative.


Based out of our Palo Alto office, you will sit at the intersection of R\&D and our core business functions—specifically Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal—ensuring that Pebl’s vast repository of global employment and compliance data is secure, accessible, and actionable.

***In\-office collaboration is required at our Toronto office Monday through Wednesday.***

**How You'll Make An Impact:**

**1\. Architect the Future (Technical \& Hands\-On Data Engineering)**

* Own the vision and execution of Pebl’s modern data infrastructure.
* Serve as the ultimate technical authority on data engineering, ensuring highly scalable, performant, and reliable data pipelines.
* Champion strict data security, privacy, and governance protocols to protect our global payroll, HR, and compliance data.

**2\. Drive Actionable Business Insights (Analytical Powerhouse)**

* Transform complex datasets into clear, actionable strategies across all departments.
* Partner with Marketing and Sales to optimize our growth funnel, CAC, and conversion rates.
* Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Legal to improve billing accuracy, payroll speed, and compliance tracking.

**3\. Champion "AI Everywhere" (AI Native Operations)**

* Lead the charge to make Pebl a truly AI\-native company.
* Bring AI capabilities to our R\&D offerings, such as enhancing our compliance assistant, Alfie.
* Engage directly with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal to embed AI into their daily workflows, driving massive internal efficiency.

**4\. Bridge the Gap (Communication \& Storytelling)**

* Act as the ultimate translator between deep technical R\&D work and overarching business objectives.
* Master the art of data storytelling to present complex insights to the executive team and the board in a compelling way.

**5\. Build and Foster the Team (Leadership)**

* **Lead the Charge:** Be a hands\-on, execution\-oriented leader who ensures delivery of strong business results.
* **Be the NBA Coach:** Recruit top\-tier talent and assemble a high\-performing team of data engineers, analysts, and AI specialists.
* **Be the Gardener:** Foster a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety to cultivate a data\-driven mindset across the entire company.

**Let's Connect If You Have:**

* **Extensive Technical Background:** 15\+ years of experience in data engineering, data science, or analytics, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* **Modern Stack Mastery:** Deep, hands\-on expertise orchestrating our specific modern data infrastructure stack: **Snowflake, Fivetran, Atlan, Looker, and Monte Carlo**.
* **AI/ML Track Record:** Proven experience deploying LLMs, machine learning models, and AI tools for both production products and internal operational workflows.
* **Cross\-Functional Business Acumen:** Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal to tie data initiatives directly to top\-line growth and bottom\-line efficiency.
* **Exceptional Communication:** A track record of weaving data into compelling business narratives for non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Work Style:** Ability to work from our Palo Alto office Monday through Wednesday to collaborate directly with the executive and R\&D teams.

**Our Commitment to You**


At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include:

* **Flexible Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge.
* **Parental Leave** – Support for growing families.
* **Health and Dental Insurance** – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones.
* **Retirement Savings \+ Employee Incentive Plan** – Plan for the future while sharing our success.


Please visit our career page for more information.

**Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**


We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise AI Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
**JOB PURPOSE**  

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Director, Enterprise AI Strategy \& Transformation leads the development and execution of the organization’s enterprise AI strategy and transformation agenda to drive measurable business value, productivity, operational efficiency, innovation, and informed decision\-making. The role serves as the organization’s AI subject matter expert and enterprise coordinating point, providing strategic guidance on AI opportunities, investments, governance, risk, technology, adoption, and value realization.  

  

The Director partners with business and functional leaders to identify, prioritize, and implement AI and intelligent automation opportunities aligned with organizational objectives and financial goals. The role initially focuses on leveraging AI to enhance financial and operational performance, including forecasting, reporting, analysis, productivity, workflow efficiency, cost management, and decision\-making, with successful capabilities and practices progressively expanded across other functions. The Director oversees the enterprise AI portfolio and lifecycle from opportunity assessment and business case development through solution selection, implementation, adoption, benefits realization, ongoing monitoring, and retirement.  

  

**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  

**AI Strategy, Portfolio \& Value Management*** Develop and maintain the enterprise AI strategy, operating model, portfolio, and roadmap aligned with corporate objectives and financial goals.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI opportunities based on strategic alignment, business value, cost, complexity, data readiness, risk, and organizational readiness.
* Develop business cases, investment recommendations, and implementation roadmaps, including build, buy, configure, or partner options.
* Establish performance measures, baseline metrics, and value\-realization frameworks to track AI adoption, ROI, productivity, cost savings, revenue impact, and other business outcomes.
* Provide executive leadership with visibility into AI investments, performance, realized benefits, opportunities, and risks.

**AI Solution Development \& Implementation*** Lead the evaluation, design, development, and deployment of AI solutions across enterprise productivity, function\-specific applications, intelligent automation, advanced AI, and emerging agentic capabilities.
* Partner with business units and end users to identify opportunities, develop practical AI\-enabled solutions, and improve processes and ways of working.
* Oversee AI pilots, proofs of concept, and enterprise implementations through the full lifecycle—from opportunity identification and feasibility through deployment, adoption, benefits realization, monitoring, and retirement.
* Coordinate with Cybersecurity, Human Resources and other stakeholders to ensure solutions are appropriately designed, implemented, adopted, and measured.
* Assess solution performance and recommend whether initiatives should be scaled, enhanced, consolidated, paused, or retired based on business value, adoption, cost, and risk.

**AI Governance, Risk \& Responsible Adoption*** Establish and maintain enterprise AI governance frameworks, policies, standards, controls, and risk\-based processes to support responsible AI adoption.
* Ensure AI initiatives are appropriately assessed for cybersecurity, privacy, data, intellectual property, legal, ethical, third\-party, model, and business continuity risks.
* Maintain an enterprise inventory of approved AI technologies, platforms, models, agents, and material use cases, with appropriate review, approval, testing, human oversight, monitoring, and escalation requirements.
* Ensure data quality, classification, access, security, information governance, and regulatory requirements are addressed before AI solutions are deployed.
* Monitor the evolving AI landscape, regulatory expectations, and associated risks, and update governance practices as required.

**Enterprise AI Adoption \& Change Management*** Lead enterprise AI literacy, adoption, and change\-management initiatives across executives, leaders, employees, technical teams, and advanced AI users.
* Develop and deliver role\- and function\-specific training, guidance, and resources to promote effective and responsible use of AI.
* Serve as the enterprise resource for AI strategy, best practices, use\-case guidance, and adoption support.
* Measure AI utilization, adoption, training effectiveness, employee feedback, and business outcomes to continuously improve AI enablement.
* Coordinate internal subject matter experts, technology teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to support successful AI adoption

**Vendor, Technology \& Partner Management*** Evaluate AI technologies, vendors, consultants, platforms, and implementation partners against business requirements, value, security, architecture, scalability, risk, and total cost of ownership.
* Manage AI technology and vendor relationships to ensure service quality, effective implementation, and value realization.
* Maintain oversight of the enterprise AI technology portfolio to identify duplicate capabilities, unnecessary licensing, overlapping solutions, and opportunities for consolidation.
* Monitor emerging AI technologies—including generative AI, large language models, predictive AI, intelligent automation, computer vision, and agentic AI—and assess their practical business applicability and potential value.

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum seven (7\) years of progressive experience in AI, data analytics, digital transformation, automation, technology, or related fields, including significant experience leading enterprise AI or generative AI adoption.

jobs.title: Vice President, Risk Management Transformation
jobs.description:
**Work Location:**

Toronto, Ontario, Canada
**Hours:**

37\.5
**Line of Business:**

Risk Management
**Pay Details:**

$185,000 \- $275,000 CAD
TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job\-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.


As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.


**Job Description:**

We are looking for a strategic and collaborative executive to lead an integrated transformation mandate across Risk Management. As Vice President, Risk Management Transformation, you will bring together business architecture, portfolio governance, program delivery and change leadership to turn strategy into measurable outcomes.  



Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Risk Management Transformation and Enablement, you will work across Risk pillars and enterprise partners to simplify how we operate, strengthen execution and help teams adopt sustainable new capabilities. This is an opportunity to influence at scale in a highly regulated, multi\-jurisdictional environment.  



**Key Accountabilities**

* Set the capability strategy and business architecture needed to advance Risk priorities and enterprise outcomes.
* Lead operating model design, including roles, decision rights, accountabilities and cross\-functional ways of working.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce duplication and improve consistency across Risk.
* Translate business strategy into practical roadmaps, including the technology, data and implementation considerations required for delivery.
* Lead portfolio planning and prioritization for complex, Risk\-wide initiatives, balancing strategic value, capacity, dependencies and risk.
* Oversee budgets, forecasting, cost transparency and benefits tracking across the portfolio.
* Establish governance and reporting that give senior leaders clear visibility into progress, outcomes, risks, issues and decisions.
* Guide the planning, sequencing and execution of complex programs with enterprise\-wide dependencies.
* Anticipate and manage delivery risks, resolve obstacles and bring forward timely recommendations and trade\-offs.
* Lead change strategies that build stakeholder alignment, colleague readiness, adoption and long\-term sustainment.
* Build strong partnerships across Risk, Technology, Finance, Communications, Change and other shared\-service teams.
* Lead with empathy and transparency, creating an environment where colleagues feel heard, supported and confident navigating change.
Develop an inclusive, high\-performing environment where different perspectives are valued and teams are empowered to deliver.  
* 

**Key Partnerships**

* Risk Management leaders and teams across all Risk pillars.
* Enterprise partners across Technology, Finance, Communications, Change Management and shared services.
* Senior executives, governance forums and program sponsors responsible for strategic prioritization and decision\-making.
Business and functional partners contributing to enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives.  
* 

  

**What You Bring**

* Significant leadership experience in one or more of the following areas: business architecture, enterprise transformation, portfolio or program delivery, change leadership or risk management.
* Experience leading complex, enterprise\-scale initiatives and operating model change in a matrixed organization.
* A track record of translating strategy into clear priorities, practical roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Strong judgment and the ability to influence, challenge constructively and build alignment with senior leaders and cross\-functional partners.
* Experience with portfolio governance, financial planning, forecasting, cost oversight or benefits tracking.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities and regulatory or operational pressure while maintaining momentum.
* Inclusive leadership skills and a commitment to creating an environment where people with different backgrounds and perspectives can contribute and succeed.
* Demonstrated emotional intelligence and executive presence, with the ability to listen with curiosity, build trust, navigate sensitive conversations and bring diverse stakeholders together through complex change.
A post\-secondary degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. Advanced education or professional credentials may be an asset but are not required.  
* 

We recognize that strong candidates may bring different combinations of education, career paths and lived experience. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed.


**Who We Are:**

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores.
